name: Broadway Boogie Woogie
promptTemplate: A Mondrian-inspired kinetic city grid running at {{traffic_speed}}x speed with {{traffic_density}} active traffic pulses in a {{palette_mode}} palette, reacting to music with {{pulse_style}} crossing flashes across a {{grid_complexity}} avenue network.

ui.title: BOOGIE WOOGIE +5
ui.tagline: Rhythmic De Stijl city grid synched to the sound

traffic_speed.hint: Speed of blocks streaming through avenues

traffic_density.hint: Number of active color pulses on the roads

pulse_style.hint: Intersection flash dynamic on the audio beat

grid_complexity.hint: Subdivide the canvas into tighter street blocks

gallery.blurb: A city grid in the spirit of Mondrian's Broadway Boogie Woogie: yellow streets on white, small blocks of red, blue and grey travelling along them like traffic, flashing at crossings in time with the music.
gallery.prompt: A city grid in the spirit of Mondrian's Broadway Boogie Woogie: yellow streets on white, small blocks of red, blue and grey travelling along them like traffic, flashing at crossings in time with the music. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
